title: Delhi-NCR feels winter chill after overnight rain, AQI improves to 'moderate'
content: Overnight rain affected various areas in Delhi-NCR, leading to a drop in temperatures and improved air quality. The city's Air Quality Index fell to the 'moderate' category after being 'poor' for two days. Visuals captured from places like Hazrat Nizamuddin railway station showed rain-soaked roads. Steady showers were reported in the Jamia Millia Islamia area late on Thursday. Dark clouds covered the city, indicating significant rainfall.

title: Azmatullah Omarzai scripts history after walking in at 5/4, smashes T20I world record
content: In a dazzling comeback, Azmatullah Omarzai rescued Afghanistan with an extraordinary century, scoring 116 runs from 50 deliveries after a shaky start against Zimbabwe. This achievement marked a record for T20I lower-order batters. His pivotal collaboration with Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai, worth 142 runs for the sixth wicket, pushed Afghanistan to a total of 221/7. Although Zimbabwe's Sikandar Raza matched him with a century, the chase ultimately proved futile.

title: US declares national emergency in 13 states to secure power grid; what it means
content: US government has declared a national emergency to address security risks posed by foreign-made electricity equipment. An executive order has been signed, allowing tighter restrictions on potentially dangerous foreign equipment. The new measures aim to protect the national grid from cyberattacks and supply disruptions. This initiative could also boost domestic manufacturers as reliance on potentially vulnerable foreign suppliers is reduced.

title: Taylor Swift donated $100,000 to rebuild flood-hit Tennessee playground in 2010
content: In 2010, Taylor Swift made a significant contribution of $100,000 to help rebuild the Kids Kingdom playground in Hendersonville after it was severely damaged by flooding. Originally built in 1996, the playground had encountered numerous safety challenges. Currently, officials are looking into a $3 million grant aimed at enhancing recreational facilities, particularly focusing on developing an all-inclusive playground for children of varying abilities.

title: Roman Reigns inspired his punches, Russell gave him a nickname: Meet Kapil Pokhariya
content: Inspired by WWE star Roman Reigns and nicknamed ‘Khatima ka Russell’ for his big-hitting prowess, Indian Army havaldar Kapil Pokhariya took an unconventional route to boxing. Growing up in a small Uttarakhand village, he went from punching homemade bags filled with mountain soil to winning bronze in the men’s 90kg category at the 2026 Asian Games. Kapil reflects on his childhood, his father’s support, his Army journey and his dream of Olympic glory.

title: Noah’s Ark mystery: Researchers find wood 30 feet underground in Turkey
content: Researchers investigating Turkey’s ship-shaped Durupınar Formation claim to have found charred and uncharred wood nearly 30 feet underground. The team believes the findings could offer clues about the biblical Noah’s Ark, but the discovery remains unverified. Earlier radar scans and soil analysis have also fuelled their claims, though independent scientific evidence is needed to establish the site’s origins.

title: George Michael’s ‘Faith’ guitar sells for $234,000 amid family dispute
content: George Michael’s guitar from his 1987 ‘Faith’ music video has sold for £234,000 at auction. The sale has sparked a family dispute, with Siobhan Bailey’s brother Gerard objecting to the auction organised by her estranged husband, Ian Belcher. Gerard claims Bailey wanted the memorabilia to go to her nieces and nephews before her death in 2014.

title: Michael Dell hails Trump Accounts as donor push grows
content: Michael Dell has endorsed the Trump Accounts initiative, which aims to provide American children with stock market investments. The program has opened approximately 9 million accounts for children under 18 and further plans to create accounts for all 70 million eligible kids. High-profile donors, including Gwynne Shotwell and Ray Dalio, are contributing funds to expand its reach.

title: ‘Thanda paani mat peena’: Woman’s advice to Vaibhav Suryavanshi wins hearts
content: Following India's triumph over New Zealand, a compassionate woman took a moment to share some heartfelt advice with cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi. In Wellington, amid post-match celebrations, she advised him to avoid cold water, suggesting warm water instead for better health. This sweet interaction touched many online for its warmth and parental-like care, as Vaibhav, hailing from Bihar, graciously accepted her wise words with a smile.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current opens free soccer league for 120 children
content: The Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in July to help children overcome financial barriers to sports. The program provides 120 players aged 8 to 10 with uniforms, Nike cleats and equipment at no cost. Supported by community partners, the initiative also offers coach stipends and referee training for teenagers. The league aims to expand access, support local families and encourage greater participation, particularly among girls.

title: Andre Agassi’s $6.5M Las Vegas land sells for $18.15M in 2026
content: Andre Agassi sold his 1.8-acre homesite in Las Vegas’ exclusive Summit Club for $18.15 million, nearly tripling the $6.5 million he paid in 2018. The sale generated an $11.65 million gain before expenses. His brother, Phillip Agassi, said the tennis legend reconsidered building a large mansion as his children grow older. The buyer’s identity remains unknown, while the property’s location and luxury surroundings add to its appeal.

title: Sir Patrick Stewart dies at 86 after battle with Alzheimer’s and Lewy body dementia
content: Sir Patrick Stewart, the celebrated British actor known for Star Trek: The Next Generation and the X-Men franchise, has died at 86 at his Los Angeles home, according to a family statement. His death follows a battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia. The acclaimed actor leaves behind a six-decade legacy across theatre, television and cinema.

title: 'Transgressions by China happen, it's not new': Arunachal CM says no intrusion along LAC
content: Pema Khandu asserted that border transgressions along the India-China frontier have been a longstanding issue, highlighting China's non-recognition of the McMahon Line. He described the recent confrontations as transgressions instead of intrusions and reassured citizens of the state's stability. Likewise, Union tourism minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat reaffirmed the safety of India's borders while working to alleviate media-induced tensions regarding the situation.

title: Devoleena Bhattacharjee defends women’s choice of keeping Karwa Chauth
content: Devoleena Bhattacharjee expressed her views on Karwa Chauth, a cherished festival where couples come together in India. She underscored the importance of personal choice in participating in such traditions. While she personally doesn't fast for the occasion, she respects its meaning for others. Devoleena believes that love should be celebrated uniquely, free from judgment. She extended heartfelt wishes for joy and deeper connections to all celebrating Karwa Chauth.

title: Trump moves to end H-1B visa deference: What it means for Indians
content: “Removing deference would not itself change green card queue positions or automatically invalidate existing H-1B approvals. However, it could affect how subsequent petitions are assessed while individuals wait for permanent residency.” “For Indian H-1B holders in the EB-2/EB-3 backlog, this rule changes the nature of the green-card wait itself. Most are living on three-year AC21 extensions, four, five, six renewals over a decade. Today each renewal presumes the last approval was correct. Under the proposed rule, every renewal becomes a fresh trial of eligibility, with specialty occupation, wage level, and employer relationship all back on the table,” he said.

title: Most of private equity in health went to west & south: Study
content: private equity investment in India’s healthcare sector is concentrated in urban hospitals in southern and western states . vast rural and underserved regions attracted little or no investment at all . over 73% of the investment was in 45 hospital groups, including 187 multispecialty hospitals and several single ones .

content: BJP is banking on twin planks of combativeness and persuasion directed at the opposition and the masses . top organisational functionaries and union ministers gave shape to the party’s strategy ahead of INDIA bloc’s rally on Nov 1 .

title: Gadkari’s 140 kmph no-challan proposal faces legal, road safety hurdles
content: road transport minister asked authorities not to issue challans to cars travelling up to 20% above the prescribed speed limit on expressways . the announcement comes at a time when speeding remains the leading cause of road crashes and fatalities in india and globally . in india, more than 58% of road crash deaths in 2024 were attributed to speeding .

title: Israel overhauls airline security after attempted flydubai hijacking
content: new directives apply to all incoming and outgoing flights operated by Israeli and foreign airlines . carriers must provide crew information at least 48 hours before departure, submit any subsequent updates no later than two hours before takeoff and issue a final list at takeoff . the measures were ordered by prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu following a security review .

title: Introspect on Varanasi, Nagpur losses, Congress tells BJP
content: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh said the MLC polls are a vote of no-confidence on Modi govt’s policies . the victory of Congress candidate in BJP stronghold of Nagpur “sends a strong message” .

title: India-EU landmark FTA likely rollout in mid-2027, says top EU lawmaker
content: a consent vote is expected by spring next year, paving the way for the trade agreement to officially enter into force mid-2027 . the "mother of all deals" is expected to be signed by mid-December 2026, with PM Narendra Modi expected to travel to Brussels .

title: Kharge says CJP not coming for rally, latter says yet to take a call
content: abhijeet Dipke and Congress chief mallikarjun Kharge are in touch for the events ahead . there is no confirmation about CJP’s participation in the rally yet . the immediate focus is on the “pub-lic impeachment” .

title: Fired US general admits leaking classified Iran, Ukraine information to journalists
content: lt. Brett Sylvia allegedly shared classified information with two reporters . he was fired by defence secretary on friday over severe misconduct . the investigation, which has been referred to the department of justice, remains ongoing .

title: Bihar Museum in world top 10, ahead of Met, Louvre
content: the barely decade-old Bihar Museum ranked ninth on the 'World's 100 Best Museums 2026' list . it is the only Indian museum in the top 100 . the rankings draw on visitor reviews, data analytics and on-site expert evaluations .

title: Rare White House visit by top US commander puts Trump's Iran strike options in focus
content: the top military commander in the middle east held a rare in-person briefing with president Donald Trump on the state of the Iran war . he briefed Trump on whether the naval blockade was achieving its objectives, the operation to guide oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz towards global energy markets, and the economic pressure campaign .

title: Helicopter crash in Bosnia: At least 4 killed, 11 injured as Italian Chinook crashes
content: the helicopter crashed during a routine training exercise in the country's north on friday . the injured personnel are in stable condition and receiving medical treatment . a helicopter operated by the european union force in bosnia crashed in an area near the town of Brcko . it was largely destroyed and lying on a lawn .

title: Former Bangladesh air force officer linked to Hasina escape video found dead
content: former flight lieutenant reportedly linked to a video purportedly showing sheikh Hasina fleeing the country on august 5, 2024 . police say an inquest report has found no external injury marks, though blood was seen coming out from his nose . his father claims an acquaintance took him out on Tuesday evening .

title: NCLT, NCLAT hijacked by corporate affairs ministry: SC
content: SC slams the corporate affairs ministry for "completely hijacking" NCLT and NCLAT . stinging remarks came from a bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and justices . the tribunal adjudicates corporate civil disputes, company law violations and insolvency proceedings .
